agenda.title: ADJOURN TO A CLOSED SESSION
agenda.note: The City Council will adjourn into a Closed Session for the purpose of discussion of pending or reasonably imminent litigation; the character, professional competence, or physical or mental health of an individual; the purchase, lease, sale, or exchange of real property; a proposed development agreement, project proposal, or financing proposal related to the development of land owned by the state or a political subdivision; and/or the deployment of security personnel, devices, or systems, pursuant to Section 52-4-205(1) of the Utah Code, Annotated.

items.title: Parkway Fields Phase E, Plat 2 - Into Warranty
October 20, 2026 Minutes - Regular City Council Meeting
A Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Approving the Second Addendum to the Ranches Golf Course Agreement

A Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Authorizing the Land Disposal Application to Proceed and Directing Staff to Begin the Notice and Public Hearing Process for a Portion of Utah County Parcel No. 38:257:0108, Designated as "Significant Real Property" Pursuant to Eagle Mountain Municipal Code 3.30.060
items.background: (Presented by City Recorder Lacie A. Messerly) This item is a request to dispose of a portion of Utah County Parcel No. 67:236:0004 designated as “Significant Real Property” in accordance with EMMC 3.30.060. The application, submitted by Mark Baum to purchase approximately 0.04 acre (1,742.4 sq/ft) of property located at Meadow Ranch, Plat 9.

items.title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Official Zoning Map and Future Land Use Map to Assign Current Zoning Designations to the Oak Hollow and Parkway Crossroads areas
items.background: (Presented by Planner, Mickie Mills) The Eagle Mountain City Council will conduct a public hearing on the proposed Future Land Use Map and Zoning Map amendments. These properties are located within the Oak Hollow development and the Parkway Crossroads area near the Pony Express and Ranches intersection. Approximately 38 acres of land for Oak Hollow and 7 acres of land for Parkway Crossroads are included in this proposal.

items.title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Enacting Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Section 17.60.085 Regarding Artificial Turf, and Amending Section 17.60.100 Residential Landscape Requirements
items.background: (Presented by Senior Planner, David Stroud) The proposed amendment adopts Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Section 17.60.085 regarding standards for the use and installation of artificial turf and amends EMMC 17.60.100 regarding rear yard landscaping.

items.title: Legislative Priorities List
